title: Probe and needle on the patient
view: Supine, seen from the patient's right side with the head to the left, looking across the right shoulder; arm at the side.
teachingPoint: Probe upright and sagittal just medial to the coracoid below the clavicle; needle in from above (behind) the clavicle, long and shallow, in line with the probe, aimed caudally.
claims: Supine, arm adducted (record); side view with the head to the left, after three clinical RAPTIR photos the owner shared (concept only).
Linear probe upright, sagittal, in the infraclavicular fossa just medial to the coracoid (record: sagittal over the infraclavicular fossa; coracoid standard anatomy).
Needle entering above the clavicle, cranial to the probe and in line with it, shallow, aimed caudally (record: posterior to the clavicle, caudal, strictly in-plane).
Dashed clavicle; ring on the coracoid.
Labels: Clavicle, Coracoid, Linear probe, Block needle, Deltoid.

geometry.why: needle enters cranial to the probe (head is left)
probe lower on the curve, below the clavicle
